article.title: Absence of Registrar on duty in his district.
article.content: When any Registrar is absent from his office on duty in his district, he may appoint any Sub-Registrar or other person in his district to perform, during such absence, all the duties of a Registrar except those mentioned in sections 68 and 72.
article.html:
11Absence of Registrar on duty in his district.

Section 11 · Part II · page 8 of the Act

When any Registrar is absent from his office on duty in his district, he may appoint any Sub-Registrar or other person in his district to perform, during such absence, all the duties of a Registrar except those mentioned in sections 68 and 72.
